info.name: Request to create a hardware type in Edgehog

body.raw:
{"query": "mutation CreateHardwareType($input: CreateHardwareTypeInput!) { createHardwareType(input: $input) { result { id handle name partNumbers { partNumber } } } }", "variables": { "input": { "handle": "hw-1", "name": "HW 1", "partNumbers": "hw-1" } }
}
